_comment: Shared config for the real-data pipeline (real/tools/*.py, pointed here via TERRAIN_ROOT) -- SECOND region alongside real/ (Remagen), same tools, same per-tile JSON formats, DEMHeightProvider/OSMManager/HistoricalObjectManager need ZERO changes to read this. Reported by the user directly: torpedo-carrier.html's Pacific setting is procedural/generic (a handful of undetailed islands, endless open water) and he wants the same real-data terrain treatment Remagen got, plus ground-attack missions -- this is the testbed region for that, not yet wired into any game file.
region: Okinawa (Naha - Kadena - Yomitan corridor, central-southern Okinawa Hontō)
regionComment: Chosen over a small, remote atoll (e.g. Truk Lagoon) specifically because it is densely mapped in Overture (real city blocks, real roads, a real port and airfield) -- the whole point of this round is MORE real detail, and a real, currently inhabited, well-surveyed island delivers that; a tiny wartime-only atoll would not.
crsComment: UTM zone 52N -- correct zone for this longitude band (126E-132E), true metre distances at this scale without the projection distortion a lat/lon-as-metres shortcut would introduce.
originComment: SW corner of the working area in UTM52N metres, rounded down to a clean 1000m -- world (0,0) in the tile-local coordinate system every tool/JSON file below uses. worldX = utmEasting - originUTM.x, worldZ = utmNorthing - originUTM.y (north = +Z). Computed directly from bboxLonLat via pyproj before being written here (not guessed): SW corner projects to (362060.5, 2893027.8), rounded down.
gridComment: tx runs 0..6, tz runs 0..8 -- covers UTM X 361000..389000, Y 2891000..2927000, comfortably containing the full bboxLonLat with margin on every side (checked against all four projected bbox corners, not assumed). 63 tiles total, comparable in count to Remagen's 56 -- deliberately NOT the full length of Okinawa Hontō (~106km), this is a first testbed region, not the whole island.

kadenaAirfield.label: Kadena airfield (runway centre) -- REAL, currently active airfield; ground-attack target, no claim this exact site saw 1945 combat, same honesty caveat as Remagen's factory/airfield placements

nahaPort.label: Naha port -- REAL, currently active commercial port; ground-attack target

yomitanBeach.label: Hagushi beach, Yomitan -- REAL location of the actual 1 April 1945 invasion landing beaches; used here as a coastal-defence/flak target site, not a claim that specific gun positions are historically documented (same caveat as Remagen's flak placements)
